P.text: In L2TokenReceiverV2::increaseLiquidityCurrentRange, the protocol uses block.timestamp as the deadline argument when interacting with the Uniswap Nonfungible Position Manager.
P.evidence_quote: In the function `L2TokenReceiverV2::increaseLiquidityCurrentRange`, the protocol currently uses `block.timestamp` as the `deadline` argument when interacting with the Uniswap Nonfungible Position Manager.

I.text: The deadline parameter should provide a protective effect by preventing pending transactions from being executed at a later time.
I.evidence_quote: This effectively **defeats the purpose of the deadline parameter**.

V.text: Using block.timestamp as the deadline makes the deadline check a no-op, so pending transactions can be executed maliciously at a later time, e.g., by MEV bots at a disadvantage to the original submitter.
V.evidence_quote: As a result, the deadline check compares `block.timestamp` against the same value, rendering it a no-op.
